_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The consensus indicates a cautious approach due to the risk-off sentiment, suggesting a downward shift in the market phase.
next_move.brains_agree: Both experts agree on the risk-off sentiment but differ in their predictions of the market's immediate direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX spikes above 20 and gold strength exceeds 90
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC momentum 30d rebounds above 70 and Fear & Greed rises to 65+
